title: Singapore Family Holiday with Universal Studios
alt: The Universal Studios globe on Sentosa island in Singapore
transport: Private airport transfers with shared coaches for tours and tickets

expert.name: Nisha Rao
expert.quote: Families do well in Bugis. Food courts, a pool, the MRT downstairs and every attraction within half an hour.
expert.tip: Start Universal Studios at opening and do the big rides first. By noon the queues double and the children are ready for the indoor shows.

summary: Five family days in Singapore. The Night Safari on arrival, a city tour and the domes at Gardens by the Bay, a full day at Universal Studios, then the Sentosa cable car and the Wings of Time show.
included: Included: 4 nights at the Village Hotel Bugis with daily breakfast; Night Safari with tram ride; half day city tour; Gardens by the Bay with Cloud Forest, Flower Dome and Jurassic World; Universal Studios one day pass; two way cable car sky pass; Wings of Time; 9 private and shared transfers; visa assistance.
not_included: Not included: international flights; visa charges; travel insurance; lunches and dinners; rides and games not named above; personal expenses.

1: Arrival at Changi Airport and private sedan transfer to the Village Hotel Bugis
Check in, then a swim and an early dinner at the hawker centre next door
Shared transfer to Mandai for the Night Safari with a tram ride
Children usually last the whole circuit, the elephants come first
2: Breakfast, then shared transfer for the half day city tour
Merlion Park, the Helix bridge, Chinatown and the civic district
Cloud Forest, Flower Dome and the Jurassic World walk at Gardens by the Bay
Supertree light show in the evening, free to watch from the lawn
3: Breakfast, then shared transfer to Resorts World Sentosa
One day pass for Universal Studios across all seven zones
Minion Land and Far Far Away for the youngest, Sci Fi City for the rest
Return in your own time, the Sentosa Express runs until late
4: Breakfast, then shared transfer to Mount Faber for the cable car
Two way sky pass over the harbour with the port below
Afternoon free on Siloso beach or at the Sentosa boardwalk
Wings of Time after dark, water jets, lasers and fire on the beachfront
5: Private sedan transfer to Changi Airport for your flight home

program.name: Theme parks and city nights
program.description: Four nights in Bugis with a pool for the afternoons, a wildlife evening at Mandai and a full day at Universal Studios.

activities.name: Night Safari with Tram Ride
activities.description: A tram ride through the Mandai park after dark, past elephants, rhinos and the cats that only wake at night.

activities.name: Half Day Singapore City Tour
activities.description: A shared coach tour past Merlion Park, Marina Bay, the Helix bridge, Chinatown and the colonial district.

activities.name: Gardens by the Bay
activities.description: Cloud Forest with its indoor waterfall, the Flower Dome and a Jurassic World trail under the Supertrees.

activities.name: Universal Studios Singapore
activities.description: A full day pass with Minion Land, Far Far Away, Ancient Egypt and the Sci Fi City coasters.

activities.name: Singapore Cable Car Sky Pass
activities.description: A two way cable car ride between Mount Faber, HarbourFront and Sentosa high above the harbour.

activities.name: Wings of Time
activities.description: A night show on Siloso beach made of water screens, lasers and fire, about twenty minutes long.

activities.name: Singapore Zoo
activities.description: An open enclosure zoo at Mandai, easy to pair with the Night Safari if the children are up for a long day.
